scope: STATIC SOURCE ENDPOINTS ONLY. No generated frames, continuous motion, song synchronization, final edit, or full scene acceptance.

inspection.note: Scratch FFmpeg-only crops are review aids at native scale, not production inputs. New operator crops must preserve reviewed functional content and be bound to their own exact bytes.

pairs.observed: Medium alternative A: same short-bob sister supports record box on RIGHT forearm/torso while LEFT phone hand rises from hip to LEFT ear. Box/red-circle sleeve, door, stance and identity are compatible; active hands and concern are readable.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Prefer A for the planning cut: phone action and worry read clearly. Medium framing intentionally omits feet; no gait claim. Box must remain mechanically supported, same size and contents, while only free arm handles one phone. This is one action, not a new shot in addition to alternative B.

pairs.observed: Full-body alternative B shows the same left-hand phone raise with right-side box support; complete shoes and stationary stance in the same closed-door setting.
pairs.motion_limits_or_required_fix: Alternative coverage of the SAME phone call, not a chronological continuation to be played after A. No body drift, box ownership switch, phone duplication or unnecessary walking. Natural hand/ear contact still requires motion inspection.

authority: Root owns canon/contract changes. Artist and reviewer are separate. No generator or GPU operation performed by reviewer.
